name: Get Plasmid Sequence
description: Unified function to retrieve plasmid sequences from either Addgene or NCBI. If is_addgene is True or identifier is numeric, uses Addgene. Otherwise searches NCBI using the plasmid name.
detailed_description: Unified function to retrieve plasmid sequences from either Addgene or NCBI. If is_addgene is True or identifier is numeric, uses Addgene. Otherwise searches NCBI using the plasmid name.
when_to_use: When you need get plasmid sequence analysis

parameters.identifier: [Required] Either an Addgene ID or plasmid name (str)
parameters.is_addgene: [Optional] Force Addgene lookup if True, force NCBI if False. If None, attempts to auto-detect based on identifier format.
